thread:
Owen Park: emergency — need to jump offline, kiddo has a fever and daycare called. i'm scheduled primary for the 23:00-03:00 UTC block, ETA back >3h. can someone cover primary now? i can do a 5m handoff if needed but i need to step out ASAP. pager active on pg-gen-5 just now.

incident-bot: Pager alert — pg-gen-5 firing (generation errors / backend timeouts) — severity: P1 — pager id 90112 — https://redwood.internal/pager/90112

Zoe Kim: i can take primary for the night. @Rajat want to be secondary? i can shadow for 3-5m then fully take over. Owen — any immediate context?

Owen Park: thanks Zoe. issue started ~12m after the 22:30 deploy (generation-service image v2.3.1). saw a burst of 503s and increased tail latency. quick mitigation attempted: partial rollback to v2.3.0 but only reduced error rate marginally. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/generation-degraded

Rajat Singh: i'll be secondary. Zoe — make sure you have kube/ops perms and the rollback snippet in your clipboard. i'll handle customer comms and perf dashboards.

Zoe Kim: have creds. running health probe now:
```
curl -sS https://gen.redwood.prod/_health | jq '.'
# expect: {"service":"ok","workers": >= 6, "tail_latency_ms": < 200}
```

Zoe Kim: health shows 4/8 pods Ready, 2 pods CrashLoopBackOff, tail latency 450ms. checking recent GC and kernel logs.

Owen Park: note — infra team toggled kernel-optimize=true in the last deploy which forces new runtime path. that might be the culprit for gen model worker instability.

Rajat Singh: mitigation options from runbook: 1) move critical traffic to model-compact route, 2) revert kernel-optimize flag, 3) scale worker pool +3 and cordon bad nodes. prefer a quick traffic pivot while we stabilize.

Zoe Kim: i'll pivot critical customers to model-compact route now (low-latency but ~5% quality delta). /ops route shift generation critical -> model-compact 100%

opsbot: routing change applied — generation critical traffic -> model-compact (requested by Zoe Kim) — propagation ~10s

Zoe Kim: routing propagated. critical traffic error-rate down to <0.5%, overall errors still ~2% due to retries. i'm going to cordon two nodes with OOM logs and scale workers +3 in the meantime.

opsbot: cordon node infra-node-17, cordon node infra-node-18 — requested by Zoe Kim — completed

opsbot: scaling gen-worker pool +3 — requested by Zoe Kim — eta ~40s

Zoe Kim: scale done. retesting health — pods stable, tail latency 220ms median. still seeing intermittent 500s on long prompt paths, plan to enable request-sampling to capture failing traces.

Rajat Singh: good. i'll draft a short customer note for CS: affected customers may have seen 30-90s retries and higher latencies between 22:35-23:05 UTC; model-compact pivot applied for critical customers. tagging @Ava (customer-success) to coordinate outreach.

Ava (customer-success): copying. i'll prepare targeted outreach for impacted enterprise customers and let you know if anyone needs SLA credit escalation.

Zoe Kim: Owen — ETA?

Owen Park: sadly >3h. please mark me out. apologizing for the chaos.

Zoe Kim: initiating formal swap. checklist: announce here, set 15m overlap shadowing window, update rota calendar, update oncall handoff doc, subscribe secondary to pager, adjust alert sensitivity for noise while stabilizing.

Zoe Kim: oncall-change: Zoe -> primary, Rajat -> secondary, Owen -> out until ~02:45 UTC. 15m overlap starting now.

oncall-bot: oncall-change acknowledged — new primary: Zoe Kim, new secondary: Rajat Singh, previous primary: Owen Park (status: out)

Rajat Singh: subscribed to pager 90112. lowering noisy alert thresholds by 30% for 45m to avoid alert storms. will revert after stabilization.

Zoe Kim: logging the commands used in case we need to reproduce:
```
# pivot route to compact model
/ops route shift generation critical -> model-compact 100%
# revert kernel-optimize flag (if required)
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/gen-service --containers=runtime KERNEL_OPTIMIZE=false
# scale workers
/ops scale pool gen-worker +3
```

Owen Park: thank you all. i've added my travel/childcare note to the rota and updated my calendar block. really appreciate the quick cover.

Zoe Kim: health steady for now — overall error rate <0.8%, tail latency 210ms median. i'll hold primary until 02:30 UTC and leave a short handoff note in the oncall notebook before a formal signback.

Rajat Singh: i'll draft the quick post-incident summary: timeline, mitigation (route pivot, cordon nodes, worker scale), customer impact. pinging @Ava for the customer outreach draft.

Zoe Kim: swap complete. will update if anything changes. :thumbsup:
